_how_to_read: Each entry: [scene time where the picture freezes, seconds to freeze]. Scene time = seconds into that scene's own animation (story scenes: before the 1.3x pace is applied, i.e. the same numbers used in beats_def.py). Holds only add time; they never speed anything up.
_phase: Phase C (voice-led): narrated slides hold only where the voice runs past the slide's last event; the rest of their timing is in retime.json.
